name: XO
roleBasis: Its homepage says: "XO is the world's largest private jet marketplace." That is the company's own claim.
summary: Marketplace and membership seller with priced deals on its homepage.
differentiator: Charter prices come from a search rather than a rate card. The homepage lists priced "deal" entries (for example $3,000 and $4,000) without saying on the page what each covers, and promotes memberships alongside.
priceNote: No hourly rate on the pages we read. A separate XO cost page loaded with almost no text and was not used.
operatorDisclosure: Not stated on the pages we read.
bestFor: Buyers who want to search and book from a phone and are open to memberships.
skipIf: You want a published hourly rate or a list of what the deals include.
